name: xoga747-fix-missing-maturities-skip-uat
description: Financial - Options and Normal - Options: the Missing_Option_Maturities output skips when nothing is missing (skipWhenFlag noMissingOptionCandidates) and writes a header when empty, as legacy MATLAB. Needs the bulk-uploader build with the flag (branch XOGA-747-missing-maturities-parity).

steps.where: code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND template_name IN ('Financial - Options','Normal - Options') AND tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND rule_data::text LIKE '%intermediateSheets.MissingOptionMaturities%'

set.rule_data: jsonb_set(rule_data, '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}', (SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN t.o->>'source' = 'intermediateSheets.MissingOptionMaturities' THEN jsonb_set(t.o || '{"skipWhenFlag":"noMissingOptionCandidates"}'::jsonb, '{options,headerWhenEmpty}', 'true'::jsonb, true) ELSE t.o END ORDER BY t.ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements(rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(o, ord)))

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE {{where}} AND rule_data::text NOT LIKE '%noMissingOptionCandidates%'
preconditions.reason: both configs carry the output and none has the flag yet
